subobjective.stem: Mention three things or people that tell us about the past.

learn to greet in another language

subobjective.stem: Mention three festivals in Nigeria and where they are held.

points: two green strips and one white in the middle
green for the land, white for peace

points: one country, one flag, English as a link language, anthem
